trigger_observed: DeepSeek-R1 7B asked zero questions in both H0 permission-only and H1 explicit preference-triage conditions.
purpose: Test whether the model can identify high-impact missing preferences when the harness forbids report generation and requires an ASK/PROCEED routing decision.
interpretation_boundary: A successful H2 shows scaffolded elicitation capability, not spontaneous clarification behavior. H2 must be reported separately from H0/H1.
